# Security policy

## Supported versions

No integration artifacts have been published yet. A security support policy for
released integrations will be documented when releases are available.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Email
nick.abbott67@gmail.com with the affected integration, Mosaic and framework
versions, reproduction details, and potential impact. Reports concerning this
repository's build or automation are welcome through the same channel.
